why: Every bot plays at Normal whatever the player picked -- the selector still renders, still shows a selection, still writes the descriptor, and the setup still persists; only the match ignores it. WHY THIS ENTRY EXISTS AT THIS SITE: an earlier shape passed the preset as `decidePlayerInput`'s fifth argument at the frame-loop call, and replacing THAT with the default was measured to leave 1801 tests green -- nothing in the tree drives a bot far enough for its aim spread to be observable, so the whole feature could have shipped dead with a full suite behind it. The preset is now closed over inside `createBotSources`, which removes the argument a caller could drop and leaves exactly one place it can still be lost: this line. Killed by the two cases that read the returned source's `difficulty` per slot, including the un-configured slot that must resolve Normal through ABSENCE rather than through this fallback being the only path. Scoped to loop.test.ts; expectFailures counts that scoped run only.
killedBy: createBotSources binds each slot its configured competence (issue #267) binds the preset into `decide`, so no caller can drop it
